changes: Translated scanner, ISO/legacy state machine and date/time/timezone composers into allocation-free Rust with fixed component arrays.
Preserved NUL termination, nine-significant-digit handling, Unicode whitespace, two-digit years, grammar fallback state and wrapping timezone arithmetic.

Returns parsed date components; native Gregorian calendar and TimeClip conversion live in cookie_date.rs. Timezone-less dates use a bounded original-host Date conversion through local_dates.rs, preserving the actual VM timezone database instead of substituting operating-system timezone data.
Removed VM usage-counter instrumentation; use i32::MAX for the pinned Node build without pointer compression.
scope: Native standalone API cookie Expires grammar; browser cookie parsing remains Chromium-owned. Full package/platform acceptance is separate.
